title: WebView automatic refresh load reduction
summary: Reduce automatic WebView refresh pressure during large active diagnostics runs.
reason: Operator investigation found automatic refresh performing broad read/render work while a long-running Tdarr Matrix audit was active, contributing to UI and system load.
behavior_before: Automatic refresh ran the full WebView read bundle every four seconds, including Tdarr Matrix diagnostics state.
behavior_after: Automatic refresh uses a lower cadence and skips heavyweight diagnostics reads outside Diagnostics, while manual refresh remains full.
manual_validation: PowerShell static guard string check for automatic refresh constants/Tdarr conditional - passed
python -m pytest targeted tests - not run: bundled Python reports No module named pytest

python -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_local_api.LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype - failed before touched refresh assertions on unrelated missing report-warnings rendered HTML expectation
rollback_plan: Revert the WebView refresh cadence and request-selection changes in apps/desktop/webview/static/assets/app.js.
notes:
WebView read/render cadence only. No backend route, media policy, queue, publish/drain, rename, settings save, launch, or filesystem mutation behavior changes.
Automatic refresh cadence raised to 15s, optional automatic reads get shorter timeouts, and Tdarr Matrix diagnostics auto-refresh is limited to the Diagnostics advanced tab.
Refreshed summaries for touched files; only the new change-packet summary was added.
